explication: MinIO is a self-hosted, S3-compatible object-storage server. Clients send S3 requests to the HTTP server; request routing and handlers expose bucket and object operations, which the object layer executes against erasure-coded disk storage. The repository also includes administration, identity, lifecycle, replication, notifications, tiering, query, and monitoring capabilities. The README establishes the product and client workflow; the file tree and sampled excerpts support the component boundaries, but do not establish every internal call path, so uncertain links are omitted.
